name: B10-0285/2026 (PPE) – Political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on European Union countries to act on Cuba. It condemns the Cuban government's repression, torture and jailing of political prisoners, including children. It asks the European Union to suspend its cooperation agreement with Cuba unless Cuba soon frees about 1,300 political prisoners and moves toward democracy. It also wants sanctions on officials responsible for repression and on the military-run business group GAESA. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament only asks the European Union to suspend the Cuba agreement and impose sanctions.
- **Who it affects:** Cuba's government, its security and military officials, and Cuban citizens and prisoners.
- **What happens next:** European Union governments and the foreign policy chief decide whether to act on these requests.
